summary: Master gender-transformative programming and reproductive health rights. Learn WHO guidelines, SOGIESC, and IASC standards. Register for expert GSRH training.
lede: Gender, sexuality, and reproductive health programmes combine rights-based service design with attention to equitable access, informed consent, confidentiality, and safeguarding. For programme managers, gender advisers, health educators, and monitoring specialists, the training addresses needs assessment and inclusive programme planning. Participants practise developing safeguarding and referral pathways, coordinating services, selecting indicators, reviewing data quality, and reporting outcomes.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape, deliver, evaluate, or govern gender, sexuality, and reproductive health services. It suits intermediate practitioners who already work with programmes, communities, health services, education, safeguarding, or monitoring data.
audience: Sexual and Reproductive Health Programme Managers
prerequisites: You should have practical experience in health, gender, sexuality education, safeguarding, community programming, monitoring and evaluation, or a related service environment. Familiarity with programme planning and basic indicator interpretation is recommended. No coding or programming is required. The course uses guided examples and sample datasets, so you do not need to bring confidential organizational data.
